scope.purpose: Design-only review of compactness and preservation of adopted publication and display-continuity commitments.

established_intent.commitment: Only the active request may publish new results. Starting a new request preserves the already displayed results until its replacement is ready. Both commitments must survive simplification.

read_only.instructions: Use the evaluator skill and captured request as sole design evidence. Verify exact hashes, inspect the captured design and intent, and return all fields required by sigil-design-review/v1. Do not edit design sources or captures. Resolve imports from source_root and links from their original linking location using the input mapping. Read only selected inputs and installed skill entrypoints/references. Do not use compiler or network.
read_only.actual_host_restrictions: Native delegation is disabled for this replay run. No evaluator has been launched. Filesystem access is unrestricted technically; scope and read-only limits are instruction-enforced. A receiving host must supply a fresh independent evaluator and describe its actual restrictions.
